answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to sign each completed job with a unique quill — a long-lived identity key whose reputation accrues only through peer-attested work. New identities must wander through low-value, audited tasks before earning high-value jobs, so a fake cannot appear fully trusted overnight. Honest histories shine saffron-bright in the ledger, while failed audits stain the key permanently. Spawning thousands of fakes means funding thousands of slow, costly reputations, which costs far more than cheating earns.
